def process(waterBodyTesting2012, waterBodyTesting2013):
    import pandas as pd

    def rate(df: pd.DataFrame, year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df.copy()
        d = d[d['Year'] == year]
        # normalize
        d['Violation'] = d['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        d['is_exceed'] = d['Violation'].isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'])
        g = (
            d.groupby(['Beach Name'], dropna=False)
            .agg(samples=('is_exceed', 'size'), exceedances=('is_exceed', 'sum'))
            .reset_index()
        )
        g['rate'] = g['exceedances'] / g['samples']
        g = g.rename(columns={'rate': f'rate{year}', 'samples': f'samples{year}', 'exceedances': f'exceedances{year}'})
        return g

    r12 = rate(waterBodyTesting2012, 2012)
    r13 = rate(waterBodyTesting2013, 2013)

    both = r12.merge(r13, on='Beach Name', how='inner')
    # exclude beaches with no samples in 2012 (shouldn't exist after groupby, but keep explicit)
    both = both[both['samples2012'] > 0]

    higher = (both['rate2013'] > both['rate2012']).sum()
    return pd.DataFrame([{'higherCount': int(higher)}])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute per-beach bacterial exceedance rate using Violation column (normalize to lowercase; exceedance if in {yes,y,true,1}); for each year separately groupby Beach Name to get samples (count) and exceedances (sum of is_exceed) and compute rate=exceedances/samples; inner-join beaches present in both 2012 and 2013 (thus excluding beaches with no 2012 samples); count beaches with rate2013 > rate2012; return single-row DataFrame [higherCount].
